t: A browser editor that helps students move from blocks to typed Python.
steps: Write and run a short Python program in frames.
Connect a micro:bit by USB to try the micro:bit version.
Check that the school browser allows WebUSB.
Ask the vendor whether the site needs the internet after the first load. The materials do not say.
Check how students can save and move their programs.
Plan a first lesson that moves a simple Scratch program into Python.
